organism.common_name: Late Jurassic Solnhofen Urvogel (Asymmetric Flight Vane)

paleobiology.chronoseries_note: Archaeopteryx is represented by a single Solnhofen horizon in this slot. Wavelength change is formalized against lineage neighbors, not against a second Archaeopteryx chronospecies.

predecessor.role: symmetric pennaceous vane; melanosome colour reconstructed by Li et al. 2010

successor.role: iridescent melanosome stacks; Li et al. 2012

governing_model.name: Schnakenberg activator-inhibitor Turing system

state_variables.u: activator (melanocyte-promoting morphogen on the feather vane)

equations: du/dt = div(D_u grad u) + gamma * (a - u + u^2 v)
dv/dt = div(D_v grad v) + gamma * (b - u^2 v)
k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
governing_model.boundary_conditions: Periodic on a square vane patch (np.roll). The patch is much smaller than the feather, so a torus stands in for a no-flux vane interior.

parameters.note: These values are a slot-3120 reconstruction chosen so the Archaeopteryx critical wavelength is 7.478e-05 m. They are not copied from the 2.9 mm Loop-1230 sibling and are not a published feather-follicle table.

empirical_claims.claim: A two-morphogen system with Du != Dv selects a finite critical wavenumber k_c.
The cubic activator-inhibitor kinetics a - u + u^2 v and b - u^2 v support diffusion-driven pattern.
Within-feather pigment bars and spots are in the reaction-diffusion class.
The isolated Archaeopteryx feather preserves melanosomes consistent with dark pigment; melanosome length is ~1 µm, far below this slot's 75 µm wavelength.
Synchrotron maps show plumage patterning on a 150 Ma Archaeopteryx.
Pennaceous, asymmetric flight feathers are present in Archaeopteryx.

scale_transfer.statement: 75 µm sits between melanosome length (~1 µm, Carney 2012) and the 2.9 mm organ-scale vane wavelength of Loop 1230. The Berlin-slab JPEG does not resolve 75 µm.
scale_transfer.scan_observable: Pearson fit of a quartic illumination plus three harmonics of the dominant frequency on the wing optical-density transect (rows 450:850, cols 750:1200).
